messages:
sasha (sec): Heads up — we just got the advisory for CVE-2026-1742 affecting OpenSSL in Ubuntu 22.04 and Alpine 3.18 base images. Remote info leak vector on TLS clients. Need to decide rebuild priority and image promotion policy. Also want to confirm KMS signing and RBAC for the signer role.

 tom (infra): can you paste the advisory? initial read — likely medium-high. attack complexity seems nontrivial but exploitability on our stacks TBD.

 sasha (sec): https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-1742 (snippet)
 summary: libssl: info leak in TLS session resumption. Affects libssl 3.0.9 and earlier. upstream patch: 3.0.10.
 impact: runtime clients that accept session resumption tickets. affected Docker bases: ubuntu:22.04-lts, alpine:3.18 (libssl3 pkg).

 maya (eng-ml): do our inference images ship system libssl or rely on pinned wheels? some model-serving containers use OS-level openssl for token fetchers. I'll grep.

 ben (sre): short checklist proposal: 1) mark vulnerable images in registry with `vuln:2026-1742` tag; 2) schedule rebuild -> bump libssl -> run smoke; 3) sign rebuilt image with KMS and promote to canary; 4) enable stricter audit logs for promotions. priority: high for public-hosted images, medium for internal-only images.

 ci-bot: Created issue #4721: "CVE-2026-1742 base image rebuild + sign" and kicked off dependency scan for affected manifests.

 elaine (platform): agree with ben. can we do a staged promotion? canary on dedicated infra first to validate model latency/regressions. also need SBOM attached to promoted image.

 sasha (sec): quick command to bump on Dockerfile (ubuntu example):
 ```
 FROM ubuntu:22.04
 RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl3=3.0.10-1ubuntu1 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 ```
 signing (example):
 ```
 gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=images --key=signer-key --plaintext-file=image.tar --ciphertext-file=image.sig
 # our promote script verifies signature and SBOM before tag push
 ```

 tom (infra): note: KMS signer will need new IAM permission `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign` (our internal name: kms:SignImage). We should create a minimal signer principal and add that to infra/roles. Will open RBAC PR.

 ben (sre): target rebuild window 05:00-07:00 UTC tomorrow to avoid peak traffic. can run parallel rebuilds for alpine/ubuntu. Need QA checklist: container boot, healthcheck pass, TLS handshake smoke, package ver check, SBOM present, signature verification.

 maya (eng-ml): I can run inference regression and token-fetcher tests in the canary cluster. Will need image refs and test harness.

 sasha (sec): I approve the RBAC change for the signer role but request audit retention bump for image promotion logs to 1y for this rollout. Add `image:promote` and `image:rollback` audit events.

 elaine (platform): I will add gating rule: require `signed: true` and `sbom:sha256` present to promote to stable. also wire the audit event exports to security project.

 tom (infra): I'll take ownership of the rebuild job and PR the IAM role change. maya owns QA, sasha owns advisory and release notes. ben will coordinate the registry tagging and block list.

 sasha (sec): thanks team. plan looks good. tagged the issue with `priority:high` for hosted images and `priority:medium` for internal. will post an update after first canary is signed. :thumbsup:
